title: Descent comparison on the actual ringed sheaf-Hom models
statement: Let (C,J,R) and (D,J′,R′) be small ringed sites with the stated sheafification hypotheses and their unbounded derived categories [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category, def-weil-abstract-derived-category]. Assume the source module category has K-injective resolutions [prop-pur-kinjective-resolutions-exist]. Let U be exact additive forgetting preserving K-injective complexes, and let the actual derived internal Homs [def-pur-derived-internal-hom] have representative isomorphisms to the localized actual Hom complexes [def-pur-hom-complex], natural on chain maps whenever the targets are K-injective. Given a natural chain comparison U HomComplex(K,I) ≅ HomComplex(UK,UI), there is a natural isomorphism between D(U) applied to the source derived internal Hom and the target derived internal Hom applied to D(U) in both variables. On every pair of K-injective complexes, it is represented by the given chain comparison, with the specified representative isomorphisms and both mapDerivedCategoryFactors legs.

source.place: Sections 0A8X and 08J7, Lemma 0A95; componentwise and localization assembly from steps 4–5 of lem-sf-ringed-forget-two-injective-hom.

proof.text: Apply [lem-sf-kinjective-hom-comparison-descent] to the actual ringed sheaf-Hom complex bifunctors and actual derived internal Hom bifunctors, the supplied natural representative isomorphisms, and the given chain comparison. Its hypotheses are precisely the supplied source K-injective resolutions, exactness and K-injective preservation. Its localization-factor equation is the required representative equation without alteration.

proof_origin.place: Formal categorical assembly of the product-total Hom and K-injective models in Sections 0A8X and 08J7.

theorem sheafHomComparisonDescent :
    ∃ derived : (derivedInternalHomOfUniverses.{c, v, r, wb} J R) ⋙ U.mapDerivedCategory ≅
        (U.mapDerivedCategory.op.prod U.mapDerivedCategory) ⋙
          derivedInternalHomOfUniverses.{d, vd, s, wa} J' R',
      ∀ (K I : CochainComplex (RingedTensorModules.{c, v, r} J R) ℤ) [K.IsKInjective]
        [I.IsKInjective],
        derived.hom.app (op (DerivedCategory.Q.obj K), DerivedCategory.Q.obj I) ≫
            (derivedInternalHomOfUniverses.{d, vd, s, wa} J' R').map
              (X := (op (U.mapDerivedCategory.obj (DerivedCategory.Q.obj K)),
                U.mapDerivedCategory.obj (DerivedCategory.Q.obj I)))
              (Y := (op (DerivedCategory.Q.obj ((U.mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj K)),
                DerivedCategory.Q.obj ((U.mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj I)))
              ((U.mapDerivedCategoryFactors.inv.app K).op,
                U.mapDerivedCategoryFactors.hom.app I) ≫
            (ρA ((U.mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj K)
              ((U.mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj I)).hom =
          U.mapDerivedCategory.map (ρB K I).hom ≫
            U.mapDerivedCategoryFactors.hom.app
              ((Functor.uncurry.obj (homComplexFunctor (R := R))).obj (op K, I)) ≫
            DerivedCategory.Q.map (chain.hom.app (op K, I))
